brief.persona: I am booking a service visit for a home water softener.
brief.objective: Book a pest control technician to inspect and remove a wasp nest from the front porch.
facts: There is a growing wasp nest located under the front porch roof.
Wasps have started entering the house when the front door opens.
The caller is available on Thursday afternoon or Friday morning.
The property is a single-family home.
preferences: Prefers an eco-friendly or pet-safe treatment method.
Would like an estimate of the visit cost before authorizing treatment.
Wants confirmation via email or text once scheduled.

adjacent: You may also arrange service for the drinking-water filtration unit on the same visit if they raise it.

authorizedCommitments: Book one service visit on any weekday within the next three weeks.

spend.basis: for this visit, though they may not be able to quote a price until they see the problem

menuHints: The main menu offers new installations on 1, billing on 2.

fields.name: agreedAmount
fields.description: Total amount agreed in USD, or empty if nothing was agreed

fields.name: appointmentStart
fields.description: Start of the booked arrival window, e.g. 2026-08-25T08:00

fields.name: appointmentEnd
fields.description: End of the booked arrival window, e.g. 2026-08-25T12:00

fields.name: secondUnitIncluded
fields.description: yes or no — whether the drinking-water unit is included in the visit

script.label: Automated menu
script.text: Thank you for calling Apex Pest Solutions. For new installations, press 1. For billing, press 2.

script.label: Operator redirect
script.text: Please hold while we transfer you to an operator.

script.label: Receptionist greeting
script.text: Apex Pest Solutions, this is Brenda. How can I assist you?

script.label: Acknowledge issue
script.text: I can certainly note down the wasp issue for our service team.

script.label: Pricing explanation
script.text: Just so you know, we cannot quote a price until a technician comes out and sees the problem in person.

script.label: Attempting transfer
script.text: Let me transfer you over to our field scheduling department to get that booked.

script.label: Hold announcement
script.text: Please remain on the line while your call is being transferred.

script.label: Queue notice
script.text: All scheduling specialists are currently assisting other customers. Please continue to hold.

script.label: System message
script.text: The scheduling queue is currently full and cannot take additional calls.

script.label: Voicemail prompt
script.text: Please leave a message with your name and telephone number, and someone will call you back within two business days. Goodbye.

script.label: Closing Confirmation
script.text: No, that's everything I need from you — you're all set. Thanks for calling, goodbye.
